deletion.conversionRule: Delete the general-intake copy within 30 days after a written pilot agreement takes effect; the agreement governs any necessary replacement business record.
deletion.exceptionRule: A documented legal duty or active dispute may suspend deletion only for the affected record; delete it within 30 days after the duty or dispute ends.

processors.purpose: Bot and abuse prevention for public forms and demo-session minting.
processors.retention: Clavenar retains only a one-way token hash for at most 300 seconds; Cloudflare controls its security-signal retention under the linked addendum.
processors.deletion: The local token hash expires automatically; requests concerning Cloudflare-held signals may also be directed to Cloudflare under its addendum.

processors.purpose: Receive minimized intake messages and conduct requested correspondence.
processors.retention: General-intake messages follow the 90-day inactive and 180-day absolute intake limits.
processors.deletion: Vanteguard Labs deletes the general-intake copy on schedule or within 30 days after a verified deletion request, subject only to the documented exception rule.

processors.purpose: Aggregate website measurement; disabled in the official 1.242.0 website build.
processors.retention: No new website event is sent by the official build while the integration is disabled.
processors.deletion: Re-enabling requires a reviewed inventory and a bounded analytics lifecycle before publication.

processors.purpose: Transmit the minimized, Turnstile-verified intake message to the controller mailbox.
processors.retention: Web3Forms states that it does not store form submissions and deletes service logs periodically, every two months.
processors.deletion: The provider does not expose a stored submission copy; its published two-month log deletion applies to service logs.
